diff --git a/overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmColourSwatch/zimmColourSwatch.css.ts b/overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmColourSwatch/zimmColourSwatch.css.ts
index 352693f..ce151ba 100644
--- a/overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmColourSwatch/zimmColourSwatch.css.ts
+++ b/overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmColourSwatch/zimmColourSwatch.css.ts
@@ -49,7 +49,33 @@ export const ZimmColourSwatch = {
       // selected, and selected without being focused. `--zimm-focus-ring` already composites the
       // same border-width/colour pair used above; `--zimm-focus-ring-offset-default` matches
       // three of Figma's four side offsets.
+      //
+      // `position: relative` + `zIndex: 1`, scoped to this focus-visible state only: the parent
+      // `swatches` row (zimmColourSwatchGroup.css.ts) is `gap: 0`, so adjacent swatches sit
+      // flush. `outlineOffset` is positive, so the ring paints *outside* this swatch's own
+      // border box — and with zero gap, that outward ring overlaps the very next swatch's own
+      // box. Both swatches are plain in-flow flex items (`position: static`, `z-index: auto`),
+      // so painting follows tree order: the later sibling paints its opaque background on top
+      // of the earlier swatch's ring wherever the two overlap, hiding exactly the shared
+      // (right-hand) edge — confirmed in a real Chromium render, before this fix, via
+      // `getBoundingClientRect`/`elementFromPoint` and a screenshot: the right edge and the
+      // right-hand slivers of the top/bottom edges were missing for every swatch with a
+      // right-hand sibling, while the last swatch in a row (nothing to its right) rendered a
+      // complete rectangle. `zIndex` lifts this swatch into a later, higher paint layer so its
+      // ring is no longer covered; `position: relative` is what makes `zIndex` apply here at
+      // all for a *general* in-flow, non-positioned element — without it `z-index` is ignored
+      // per spec. (A `swatch` specifically is also a direct flex item of `swatches`, and the
+      // Flexbox spec carves out flex items as one exception where `z-index` alone establishes
+      // a stacking context even while `position` stays `static` — confirmed empirically here
+      // too, `z-index` alone did already fix this swatch's own outline. `position: relative` is
+      // kept anyway: it costs nothing — no `top`/`left`/etc. offset is set, so it does not move
+      // the box — and it keeps this rule correct even if `swatch` is ever composed inside a
+      // non-flex parent, rather than depending on a layout detail owned by a sibling file.)
+      // Neither property is set outside `_focusVisible`, so normal (unfocused) stacking is
+      // completely unaffected.
       _focusVisible: {
+        position: 'relative',
+        zIndex: 1,
         outline: 'var(--zimm-focus-ring)',
         outlineOffset: 'var(--zimm-focus-ring-offset-default)',
       },

content.content:
1	import type { SystemStyleObject } from '@chakra-ui/react';
2	
3	/**
4	 * Recipe for the PDP colour-swatch group — the "Colour: Bay Blue" label row, and (when there is
5	 * more than one populated colour) the row of ZimmColourSwatch rectangles beneath it. This recipe
6	 * only lays the group out; each swatch's own fill/border/focus styling stays in the sibling
7	 * ZimmColourSwatch atom's own recipe.
8	 *
9	 * Values below are read directly off Figma for this exact component, not estimated — node
10	 * 40000307:13867 ("ColourOptions"), within Zimmermann_Design_System_2026.
11	 *
12	 * Six parts:
13	 *   - `root` — outer vertical flex container: the label row above, the swatches row below.
14	 *     Capped to a fixed `maxWidth` (`GROUP_RESERVED_WIDTH`, see below) unconditionally — not just
15	 *     when paginated — so `labelName`'s truncation CSS always has a definite width to truncate
16	 *     against. See this part's own baseStyle comment for the full explanation.
17	 *   - `label` — the label row ("labelContainer" in Figma): the label-group (the two
18	 *     "Colour:"/name text pieces — laid out via a plain Chakra-prop wrapper in the component
19	 *     itself, not a seventh part here; see index.tsx's own comment for why) plus the pagination
20	 *     controls, right-aligned purely via the label-group's own `flex: 1 0 0` rather than an
21	 *     absolute-position hack.
22	 *   - `labelName` — the dynamic colour-name text specifically (e.g. "Bay Blue"). Gets its own
23	 *     part, unlike the static "Colour:" piece beside it, because it alone carries the
24	 *     Figma-mandated truncation behaviour: "If Label/Colour name is longer, use truncation"
25	 *     (this node's own interaction annotation).
26	 *   - `swatches` — the horizontal row of rendered ZimmColourSwatch children. Once paginated
27	 *     (`isPaginated`), reserves a fixed page-width footprint regardless of how many items the
28	 *     current window actually renders — see its own baseStyle comment below for the layout bug
29	 *     this prevents.
30	 *   - `pagination` — wrapper around the two chevron buttons.
31	 *   - `pageButton` — each individual chevron button (24x24, holding a 16px ZimmIcon).
32	 */
33	
34	/**
35	 * Matches `SWATCHES_PER_PAGE` in this component's own index.tsx (Figma's own interaction
36	 * annotation: "Pagination appears if there are more than 4 swatches"). Kept as its own literal
37	 * here rather than imported across files — this recipe stays a self-contained, co-located file,
38	 * the same precedent the sibling zimmColourSwatch.css.ts already sets for a state-dependent
39	 * baseStyle function. If `SWATCHES_PER_PAGE` in index.tsx ever changes, update this to match.
40	 */
41	const PAGE_SIZE = 4;
42	
43	/**
44	 * The reserved 4-swatch-wide footprint: PAGE_SIZE swatches at the atom's own fixed 48px width
45	 * (`--zimm-scale-1200` — see zimmColourSwatch.css.ts's `swatch.width`), with no per-swatch gap
46	 * (`swatches.gap` below is 0, same as the atom's own adjacency). Two consumers share this one
47	 * value rather than each typing their own copy of the same `calc(...)` expression:
48	 *   - `swatches.width`/`minWidth`, applied only once paginated (see that part below) — keeps the
49	 *     footprint constant across a full page vs. a shorter final page.
50	 *   - `root.maxWidth`, applied unconditionally regardless of pagination (see that part below) —
51	 *     caps the whole component so `labelName`'s truncation CSS always has a definite width to
52	 *     truncate against.
53	 */
54	const GROUP_RESERVED_WIDTH = `calc(${PAGE_SIZE} * var(--zimm-scale-1200))`;
55	
56	export const ZimmColourSwatchGroup = {
57	  parts: ['root', 'label', 'labelName', 'swatches', 'pagination', 'pageButton'],
58	
59	  baseStyle: ({ isPaginated }: { isPaginated?: boolean }): Record<string, SystemStyleObject> => ({
60	    root: {
61	      display: 'flex',
62	      flexDirection: 'column',
63	      // 8px between the label row and the swatches row. No background here — background lives
64	      // per-swatch, already handled by the atom's own recipe.
65	      gap: 'var(--zimm-scale-xs)',
66	      // Unconditional cap, regardless of `isPaginated` — this is a bug fix, not a stylistic
67	      // choice. `root` otherwise has no width of its own (deliberate — see the `swatches` part
68	      // below for why a short, non-paginated row must still size naturally to its actual content)
69	      // so it has no ceiling for `labelName`'s truncation CSS to truncate against: confirmed via
70	      // real Chromium rendering that a long enough colour name simply grows `root` (and the
71	      // flex-grown `labelName` span inside it) past this footprint with no ellipsis, unless some
72	      // ancestor happens to impose a definite width of its own. Capping `root` itself to the same
73	      // reserved footprint `swatches` already reserves once paginated makes truncation
74	      // self-contained in every context, rather than depending on whatever the eventual PDP page
75	      // does or doesn't constrain. `maxWidth`, not `width`: `root` must still be free to render
76	      // narrower than this when content is short (e.g. one or two short colour names) — this only
77	      // ever stops it from growing past the cap. Does not change the swatches row's own sizing
78	      // behaviour (still `100%` when non-paginated, see below) — it only changes what that `100%`
79	      // now resolves against.
80	      maxWidth: GROUP_RESERVED_WIDTH,
81	    },
82	
83	    label: {
84	      display: 'flex',
85	      alignItems: 'center',
86	      // 24px. Matches spacing.xl exactly, so the named step is used rather than the numerically
87	      // identical --zimm-scale-600 alias — see bottomBar.css.ts's own `var(--zimm-scale-xl)`
88	      // usage for the same 24px value elsewhere in this codebase.
89	      height: 'var(--zimm-scale-xl)',
90	      // 8px between the label-group and the pagination controls.
91	      gap: 'var(--zimm-scale-xs)',
92	    },
93	
94	    labelName: {
95	      textStyle: 'caption',
96	      color: 'var(--zimm-color-text-default)',
97	      // The truncating half of the label-group's two text pieces (the static "Colour:" text
98	      // beside it never truncates — see index.tsx). `flex: 1 0 0` lets it consume the
99	      // label-group's remaining width; `minWidth: 0` is required for a flex item to actually
100	      // shrink below its content size instead of overflowing; the rest is the standard
101	      // single-line-ellipsis triad.
102	      flex: '1 0 0',
103	      minWidth: 0,
104	      overflow: 'hidden',
105	      textOverflow: 'ellipsis',
106	      whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
107	    },
108	
109	    swatches: {
110	      display: 'flex',
111	      // Non-paginated (<= SWATCHES_PER_PAGE populated colours): sizes naturally to however many
112	      // swatches are actually present. Unchanged, deliberately out of scope for this fix — there
113	      // is no confirmed design value either way for a 2- or 3-colour row's width, so nothing was
114	      // invented here.
115	      //
116	      // Paginated (> SWATCHES_PER_PAGE populated colours, windowed to a fixed PAGE_SIZE-wide
117	      // slice per page): a plain `100%` here resolves against `root`'s own width — but `root` has
118	      // no explicit width of its own, so it auto-fits to its widest child, which is this very
119	      // element. That circular relationship meant the *rendered* width tracked how many items the
120	      // current window actually held (192px for a full 4-item page, 96px for a 2-item final
121	      // page), so `root` — and `label` above it, itself 100% of that same `root` — visibly
122	      // resized between pages. Confirmed directly in a running Storybook: the pagination chevrons
123	      // jumped position between the two pages of the `Paginated` story. Reserving
124	      // GROUP_RESERVED_WIDTH regardless of the current page's real item count breaks that
125	      // loop — the footprint stays constant across every page, full or partial. A partial final
126	      // page's unused space simply remains empty to the right: the flex default
127	      // `justify-content: flex-start` already left-aligns the rendered items, so nothing further
128	      // is needed for that.
129	      width: isPaginated ? GROUP_RESERVED_WIDTH : '100%',
130	      ...(isPaginated ? { minWidth: GROUP_RESERVED_WIDTH } : {}),
131	      // Confirmed directly off the Figma export, not a stylistic default: the 4-swatch example
132	      // measures exactly 192px total width for four 48px-wide swatches (4 x 48, no gap
133	      // contribution) — swatches sit directly adjacent. Do not add a gap here; that would be a
134	      // real deviation from the design, not a stylistic default.
135	      gap: 0,
136	    },
137	
138	    pagination: {
139	      display: 'flex',
140	      alignItems: 'center',
141	      // No inter-button gap value exists in the Figma export handed to this step — left at the
142	      // flex default (no `gap` declared at all) rather than invented. Revisit if a designer
143	      // confirms a real value.
144	    },
145	
146	    pageButton: {
147	      display: 'flex',
148	      alignItems: 'center',
149	      justifyContent: 'center',
150	      width: 'var(--zimm-scale-xl)', // 24px
151	      height: 'var(--zimm-scale-xl)', // 24px
152	      // Resets the native <button> UA chrome so the box is exactly the 24x24 the design calls
153	      // for, with the 16px ZimmIcon centred inside it by the flex alignment above.
154	      padding: 0,
155	      border: 'none',
156	      background: 'none',
157	      cursor: 'pointer',
158	      // No confirmed Figma spec for a disabled visual treatment on this control — same "leave an
159	      // unspecified visual state alone rather than invent one" precedent as swatch-group's own

That's **more than the two-file manifest**, and one of the extras is the file the brief named explicitly as off-limits.

### 2. The two authorized files — delivered exactly as specified

**`/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmColourSwatchGroup/zimmColourSwatchGroup.css.ts`**
- `GROUP_RESERVED_WIDTH` defined once (line 54): `` `calc(${PAGE_SIZE} * var(--zimm-scale-1200))` `` with `PAGE_SIZE = 4` — same value as the old `PAGINATED_SWATCHES_WIDTH`. Repo-wide grep for `PAGINATED_SWATCHES_WIDTH` returns zero hits — fully renamed, nothing stale left behind.
- Used exactly 3 times in code: line 80 (`maxWidth: GROUP_RESERVED_WIDTH,` — new, on `root`), line 129 (`width: isPaginated ? GROUP_RESERVED_WIDTH : '100%',` — renamed, `swatches`), line 130 (`...(isPaginated ? { minWidth: GROUP_RESERVED_WIDTH } : {}),` — renamed, `swatches`). Two more mentions are in comments only (lines 14, 124).
- `root`'s new `maxWidth` is **not** inside any conditional — line 80 sits as a plain sibling property inside the unconditional `root: { display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 'var(--zimm-scale-xs)', maxWidth: GROUP_RESERVED_WIDTH }` object, applied regardless of `isPaginated`.
- `label`, `labelName`, `pagination`, `pageButton` parts contain no `GROUP_RESERVED_WIDTH`/width-related additions — content is self-consistent with no visible drive-by edits. (Caveat: since this whole file is untracked with no prior commit, I can't produce a byte-level pre/post diff — this is a content-plausibility check, not a git-verified one.)

**`/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmColourSwatchGroup/index.test.tsx`**
- Exactly two new tests, both non-tautological: `caps root to the reserved 4-swatch footprint...` (non-paginated, default 3-colour fixture, asserts `rootStyles.maxWidth` equals the calc() string **and** `.not.toBe('none')`) and `keeps the same root maxWidth cap once paginated too...` (6-colour fixture, confirms 4 rendered radios i.e. `isPaginated===true`, same assertion).

**Other checks:** `npx tsc --noEmit` → 0 errors/0 output. Repo-wide grep for `ZimmColourSwatchGroup` finds only its own 4 files + the `theme/components/index.ts` registration — no premature PDP/product-view coupling. `git diff -- overrides/app/components/product-view/index.tsx` is empty (Step 1 confirmed zero diff). `theme/foundation/**` shows no diff and no status entries — Tier 1 untouched. `index.tsx`/`index.stories.tsx` in the group folder show no maxWidth/`GROUP_RESERVED_WIDTH` content and older mtimes (03:44) than this round's files (11:47/untracked) — consistent with "not touched." ### 3. The hard-stop violation

`git diff -- overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmColourSwatch/zimmColourSwatch.css.ts` is **not empty**. There is no untracked scratch/probe file in that folder (checked — none found); instead the atom's actual recipe file carries a real, fully-written change inside the `swatch` part's `_focusVisible` state:


backed by a 20-line comment explaining a focus-ring stacking/paint-order fix — content-wise, clearly the other track's focus-outline bug fix, but it is sitting as a live, uncommitted modification to the shared, tracked file, not confined to an inert artifact. The brief pre-cleared exactly one kind of finding here ("an untracked scratch file... don't flag it"); this is a materially different thing — a substantive change to the production recipe itself, in the one folder the brief said "must not have [been] touched... at all."
